bio: Daughter of Judge J. Lawrence Smith; 5th cousin 5 times removed via Job Smith. Augustus Saint-Gaudens made a marble bust (1884, carved by 1888) and a bronze relief medallion (1884, cast 1893) of her, both at the Metropolitan Museum of Art and released by the Met as CC0 ([R4-S1]).
